layout.body:
https://www.hamiltonfitness.com
Home Service News Careers Contact
Welcome to Hamilton Fitness Center!
Your health and wellness are our priority.
Facilities: -State-of-the-art gym equipment - Indoor swimming pool - Fitness classes (Yoga, Pilates, Zumba) - Personal training sessions
Membership Plans: -Monthly: $40 - Quarterly: $100 - Annual: $350
Visit us at www.hamiltonfitness.com or call 555-1234 for more information.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the fitness center?

options.A: It is associated with a local hospital.
options.C: It has personal trainers on staff.
options.D: It offers a family membership plan.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 原文依据：‑ Fitness classes (Yoga, Pilates, Zumba) ‑ Personal training sessions 翻译：健身课程（瑜伽、普拉提、尊巴）；私人训练课程 选项分析： A. 它和当地医院合作 →错误，全文没有提到医院相关信息。 B. 它提供游泳课程 →错误，仅有室内泳池设施，没有游泳课程。 C. 配备私人教练工作人员 →正确，提供 personal training sessions 私人训练课，可以推断有在岗私人教练。 D. 提供家庭会员套餐 →错误，会员方案只有月、季度、年卡，无家庭套餐。

questions.stem: What information does the webpage NOT provide?
questions.analysis: 答案：D 原文依据：Your health and wellness are our priority；Facilities；Membership Plans；Visit us at www.hamiltonfitness.com or call 555‑1234 for more information. 翻译：您的健康是我们首要目标；设施列表；会员方案；访问网站或者拨打电话获取更多信息。 选项分析： A. 健身中心的目标 →错误，“Your health and wellness are our priority” 即为机构目标。 B. 健身中心提供的服务 →错误，Facilities 板块列举全部服务项目。 C. 会员选择方案 →错误，Membership Plans 列出月 / 季 / 年会员。 D. 健身中心实体地址 →正确答案 NOT provide；只给网址与电话，没有给出实际物理地址。
